prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in League City, Texas. Injury: neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1367; do not mention it.)
text: I was making a left turn at a green light when a pickup truck coming from the opposite direction crossed into my lane and struck the front driver's side of my vehicle. I had already started into the intersection and had nowhere to go to avoid the impact. The airbags deployed and my car spun partway around before stopping. I got out and noticed immediate stiffness in my neck and a sharp ache in my lower back. I remained at the scene until the police officer arrived, and I gave my statement and provided my insurance information. The other driver admitted at the scene that they had not seen my car. Later that day I was evaluated for neck and back strain and was advised to rest and follow up with my doctor. I am submitting this account to support my claim for damage to my vehicle and for medical expenses resulting from the collision.
